messages.subject: Devour
messages.body_plain:
Hi Michael, I am interested in modelling for lizard embryos and I looked around to see if you posted here anything about the Devour model you mention on "Mitchell, N.J., et al., Reptile embryos and climate change:Modelling limits of viability to inform translocation decisions,
Biological Conservation (2016)".

Do you have the script you used? Is it public?

Thank you
